links.comparator_used: Fixed token-dependent chunking baseline in otherwise identical RAG pipelines (Gemini 1.0 Pro, 30 postoperative rhinoplasty questions)
links.outcome: Medical accuracy, clinical relevance, and retrieval precision/recall/F1
links.effect: Adaptive vs baseline: accuracy 87% (Likert 2.37 ± 0.72) vs 50% (1.63 ± 0.72; p = 0.001); relevance 93% (2.90 ± 0.40); precision 0.50 vs 0.17, recall 0.88 vs 0.40, F1 0.64 vs 0.24. Proposition and semantic chunking also improved all metrics over baseline, though less than adaptive.
links.quote: Adaptive chunking achieved the highest accuracy-87% (Likert 2.37 ± 0.72) versus baseline 50% (1.63 ± 0.72; p = 0.001)-and the highest relevance (93%, 2.90 ± 0.40).

design_hint: retrieval grounding with adaptive chunking strategy
